profile.availability: Open to Learning & Development, Educational Technology, HR, People Operations, Instructional Design, Talent, and Research opportunities
profile.intro: M.Sc. Educational Technology student with a background in Psychology and experience across Learning & Development, digital learning operations, instructional design, HR processes, talent research, and data analytics. I combine a people-centered, analytical, and technology-oriented approach to learning and HR processes.

experience.title: Digital Learning & Operations Assistant / Learning Support Assistant
experience.description: Support the end-to-end coordination of internal learning and development programs, including scheduling, participant communication, logistics, virtual delivery, follow-up, and evaluation. Administer Moodle-based learning environments, coordinate digital learning operations, create learning materials and multimedia content, support virtual and hybrid programs, analyze participation data, and use AI and automation tools to improve workflows.

experience.title: Educator / Program & Operations Support
experience.description: Managed learning activities, schedules, learner communications, administrative records, and operational tasks for large cohorts. Maintained structured learner and performance records, coordinated communication between learners, parents, colleagues and administrators, developed instructional materials, and prepared reports supporting learner progress and educational decision-making.

experience.title: Psychology Lecturer
experience.description: Delivered psychology instruction using learner-centered teaching strategies, interactive learning activities, and digital educational resources. Applied behavioral analysis and research-methods knowledge to examine learning patterns, performance, and learner feedback while maintaining academic records and assessment documentation.

work.title: From Paper to Digital — Redesigning Employee Onboarding
work.summary: An interactive digital onboarding experience designed to transform paper-based employee onboarding into a structured, engaging, and measurable digital learning journey.
work.detail: Designed an interactive onboarding experience from the perspective of an HR and L&D working student. Applied situated and scenario-based learning, developed interactive hotspots and decision activities, structured progression, knowledge checks, and KPI-based evaluation.
work.challenge: Improve onboarding by reducing scattered communication, printed documentation, manual processes, and limited process tracking while maintaining human connection.
work.approach: Problem analysis → learning objectives → onboarding journey → scenario design → interactive activities → KPI evaluation.

work.title: From Feedback to Action — Evaluating Training Effectiveness
work.summary: An L&D analytics project evaluating a half-day employee workshop using the Kirkpatrick four-level evaluation model.
work.detail: Designed an evaluation framework covering Reaction, Learning, Behavior, and Results. Created a structured workbook with raw feedback, Kirkpatrick analysis, dashboard reporting, practical recommendations, and measurable KPIs.
work.challenge: Understand whether training creates meaningful learning, behavioral application, and organizational outcomes.
work.approach: Training evaluation design → feedback collection → Kirkpatrick analysis → dashboard → recommendations.
work.result: Structured training evaluation and KPI framework

work.title: Designing an Employee Development Journey
work.summary: A story-driven employee development experience focused on talent management, career development, and learning & development.
work.detail: Created a fictional employee scenario and designed an interactive development journey connecting career ambition with development needs, SMART goals, learning, practice, feedback, and progress.
work.challenge: Show how employee development can move beyond training toward continuous learning, practice, feedback, and workplace application.
work.approach: Career ambition → development need → SMART goal → learning → practice → feedback → progress.

work.title: Technology Talent Research & Sourcing Project
work.summary: Independent research into European technology talent pools, engineering skill demand, regional technology hubs, and talent ecosystems.
work.detail: Researched technology talent markets and university talent pipelines using structured online research, Boolean search, LinkedIn, and StepStone research approaches. Developed a framework for talent mapping, candidate research, workforce planning, and talent intelligence.
work.challenge: Understand technology talent ecosystems and identify relevant talent pools and skill profiles.
work.approach: Market research → talent ecosystem analysis → Boolean sourcing → talent mapping → workforce planning.
work.result: Structured technology talent research and sourcing framework

work.title: Microlearning Course — AI Prompting
work.summary: An interactive microlearning course focused on effective AI prompting and AI literacy.
work.detail: Designed modular learning content using Moodle and H5P. Developed videos, branching scenarios, quizzes, practice tasks, and interactive activities to encourage active learner participation.
work.challenge: Break an emerging technical topic into concise and practical learning experiences.
work.approach: Content structuring → microlearning design → interactive activities → practice → assessment → LMS implementation.

work.title: Fix the Broken Process — Interactive Scenario-Based Digital Learning
work.summary: An interactive e-learning module focused on workplace communication, decision-making, and data-driven problem solving.
work.detail: Created realistic workplace scenarios where learners analyze business process challenges, identify bottlenecks, evaluate actions, and make informed decisions. Developed branching decision flows, multimedia assets, learner documentation, and an onboarding-style instructional video using Camtasia.
work.challenge: Create an active learning experience that connects instructional content with realistic workplace decision-making.
work.approach: Workplace scenario → process analysis → branching decisions → multimedia learning → learner reflection → application.

work.title: Virtual Museum on Adaptive Learning
work.summary: An immersive 3D virtual museum exploring adaptive learning and educational technology.
work.detail: Developed themed spaces covering personalization, learner models, and learning tools. Designed step-by-step learning pathways and interactive elements to support exploration in an immersive environment.
work.challenge: Explore how immersive environments can support personalized and adaptive learning experiences.
work.approach: Learning concept → immersive environment → themed spaces → learning pathways → interactive exploration.

work.title: MarketAR — Interactive AR Christmas Market Experience
work.summary: An AR-based Christmas market navigation and learning experience designed using user-centered design principles.
work.detail: Developed an interface prototype for AR-based navigation and learning. Applied user-centered design, usability testing, and iterative improvement to explore navigation, interaction, and user experience.
work.challenge: Explore how augmented reality can create an interactive way for users to navigate and learn within a real-world environment.
work.approach: User research → interface design → prototype → usability testing → iteration.

work.title: LMS Migration & Data Analytics Dashboard
work.summary: An end-to-end simulation of a corporate LMS migration and analytics rollout covering data governance, transformation, validation, and dashboard reporting.
work.detail: Created structured datasets for users, courses, and completions. Developed data cleansing logs, source-to-target mapping, validation rules, cleaned import-ready datasets, and executive-oriented Excel dashboards using Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts.
work.challenge: Demonstrate how learning data can be migrated, governed, validated, and transformed into actionable training KPIs.
work.approach: Raw data → data governance → cleansing → transformation → validation → dashboard → KPI reporting.
work.result: Corporate LMS migration and analytics simulation

work.title: Learning Analytics Dashboard — Open University Learning Analytics Dataset
work.summary: A reproducible learning analytics project analyzing learner performance, engagement, completion, dropout, and virtual learning environment activity.
work.detail: Built an ETL workflow using Python and Pandas to process learner, assessment, course, registration, and VLE datasets. Developed exploratory analyses and an interactive Plotly Dash interface for stakeholder-oriented exploration.
work.challenge: Understand learner behavior and identify relationships between engagement, performance, completion, and dropout.
work.approach: Data collection → ETL → exploratory analysis → learner behavior analysis → visualization → dashboard.

work.title: AI Education & Learning Analytics Dashboard
work.summary: An interactive Tableau dashboard examining the impact and effectiveness of AI-supported learning using meta-analytic educational data.
work.detail: Compared AI-supported learning across K–12 and university education, subject areas, and application modes. Explored relationships between educational context, subject area, AI usage, and learning effectiveness.
work.challenge: Understand how educational context and AI usage relate to learning effectiveness.
work.approach: Data exploration → comparative analysis → behavioral insight → visualization → evidence-based interpretation.

work.title: Didact — A DO-ID-Based Prompting Scaffold for Supporting Human Creativity in Instructional Design
work.summary: An exploratory research project investigating how generative AI can support instructional design while preserving human reflection, decision-making, and creativity.
work.detail: Proposed and evaluated Didact, a prompting scaffold based on the Decision-Oriented Instructional Design model. Conducted a within-subject exploratory study with six participants and analyzed idea diversity, reflection depth, and exploration of alternatives.
work.challenge: Explore how AI can assist instructional design without replacing human reflection and creative decision-making.
work.approach: Research design → DO-ID framework → AI prompting scaffold → participant study → artifact analysis → interpretation.
work.result: Preliminary exploratory evidence for structured AI-assisted instructional design

work.title: Effect of Whiteboard Animation Versus Slide Animation on Student Academic Learning Outcomes
work.summary: A quasi-experimental study examining whether instructional video format affects student learning outcomes and perceptions.
work.detail: Compared whiteboard animation with animated slides using matched instructional content, narration, and duration. Included 34 university students and evaluated learning outcomes, interest, novelty, and conventionality using pre-test, post-test, IMI, and UEQ measures.
work.challenge: Examine whether different instructional video formats influence learning outcomes and learner perceptions.
work.approach: Quasi-experimental design → matched instructional materials → pre/post testing → perception measures → statistical analysis.
work.result: Evidence-based evaluation of instructional video formats

work.title: Cognitive Suite
work.summary: A psychology-oriented experimental research project developed using PsychoPy.
work.detail: Developed a technology-supported experimental research environment for behavioral and cognitive research.
work.challenge: Apply experimental technology to behavioral and cognitive research.
work.approach: Experimental design → PsychoPy implementation → behavioral research environment.

education.details: GPA: 1.4. Relevant areas include Learning Systems, Instructional Design, Learning Analytics, Multimedia Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Human-Centered Design, Data Analysis, and Explainable AI in Education.

Thesis: Parental Responsiveness, Psychological Reactance and Moral Disengagement in Adolescents. Focused on behavioral research, psychological assessment, quantitative research methods, and statistical analysis.
Focus areas included Curriculum Design, Teaching Practice, and Educational Assessment.
Focus areas included psychology, behavioral science, research methods, assessment, and human behavior.

principles.title: Design around people
principles.text: Effective learning and people processes begin with an understanding of how people think, behave, interact, communicate, and develop.

principles.title: Connect technology to purpose
principles.text: Technology should serve a clear learning or organizational purpose by making experiences more effective, accessible, interactive, and efficient.

principles.title: Use evidence to improve
principles.text: Learning and people decisions become stronger when research, learner behavior, feedback, assessment, and data are used to guide decisions and iteration.
